verdict.rationale: Superpowers keeps a first-party RELEASE-NOTES.md in the repo. It describes skill-level changes per release, such as the worktree-removal fix, the plan-scoped sdd-workspace, the renaming of testing-anti-patterns.md, and new harness support, so a developer can review what changed before updating. Missing for 10: evidence of version numbers or dates on each entry, independent or hands-on confirmation that every release ships notes, and any surfacing of notes at update time (updates are a plain reinstall).

support.subject: As a developer, releases ship with notes or a changelog so I can see what changed in the skills before I take an update

citations.quote: This release also adds a native plugin manifest for the Antigravity Marketplace
Worktree removal no longer destroys untracked files.
Grok Build CLI added to the install docs.
